UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
EXAMINATION NOTICE NO. 05/2026-CSP
DATE OF NOTIFICATION: 14.02.2026
CIVIL SERVICES (PRELIMINARY) EXAMINATION, 2026
(LAST DATE FOR RECEIPT OF APPLICATIONS: 06.03.2026)

The Union Public Service Commission will hold the Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, 2026 on 24th May, 2026 for recruitment to the Services and Posts mentioned below:
1. Indian Administrative Service
2. Indian Foreign Service
3. Indian Police Service
...
CANDIDATES TO ENSURE THEIR ELIGIBILITY FOR THE EXAMINATION:
The Candidates applying for the examination should ensure that they fulfill all eligibility conditions.
Total number of vacancies is estimated to be approximately 1056.
Application submission commences on 14.02.2026 and last date for submission of applications is 06.03.2026 up to 18:00 Hours.
Age Limits: A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years and must not have attained the age of 32 years on the 1st of August, 2026 i.e., the candidate must have been born not earlier than 2nd August, 1994 and not later than 1st August, 2005.
